# Kinesis compute apps

You operate the **Compute** side of [portal.kinesis.network](https://portal.kinesis.network). Live UI wins over this file and over [docs.kinesis.network](https://docs.kinesis.network). URLs: [kinesis-network-links](sand-workflow:kinesis-network-links).

Do not invent buttons or SKUs you have not just seen. Do not hold wallets or keys. Do not leave paid compute running.

## Model

A **project** groups **apps** (containers). At launch pick **Serverless**, **New grid**, or **Use an existing grid**. You do not pick a specific stranger’s machine. Shared/Serverless and Grids pull from the pool. Grids can be shared across apps or accounts ([Understanding Grids](https://docs.kinesis.network/getting-started/running-llms-with-kinesis-network/understanding-grids)).

How-it-works “grid” is the global pooled fabric. Product **Grids** are org-scoped resource groups. Keep those distinct.

Docs still mention a “Location” wizard step. Live wizard is **Source / Runtime / Network / Execution / Resources**.

LLM positioning and True-Util: [Running LLMs](https://docs.kinesis.network/getting-started/running-llms-with-kinesis-network). True-Util applies to Shared/Serverless, not to reserved Grids.

## Compute sources (docs)

[Understanding Compute Sources](https://docs.kinesis.network/getting-started/running-llms-with-kinesis-network/understanding-compute-sources):

- **Shared Compute** (live: Serverless): Kinesis-managed, multi-tenant, pay-per-use. Docs: billed by CPU milliseconds, GPU milliseconds, RAM and VRAM bytes used. If the app is idle and not using CPU or GPU, no corresponding compute charges. Suited to prototyping and non-critical work. Skip this section in docs if an admin already shared Grids with the account.
- **Grids**: compute you control (Kinesis-provisioned or your own). Billed on reserved time. **Full price when active**: one or more apps not Stopped (Running or Starting). **Storage-only when hibernated**: no apps, or all apps Stopped. An app can use multiple pools.

Quote live portal rates. Do not invent millisecond prices.

Docs have **no** Getting Started page for provision / Wake / Hibernate / Deprovision. Those exist on live My Servers. Live UI wins.

## Sidebar (Compute)

App Management: My Projects, App Gallery. Compute Cloud: My Servers, My Grids. Observability: Monitoring, Cost Analysis. Account: Billing (Balance and Payment, Invoices), Settings, Support. Footer: Credits.

Projects: https://portal.kinesis.network/dashboard/projects

## Project and gallery

My Projects → `+ New Project`. Card menu: Start Apps, Stop Apps, Share, Rename, Delete.

App Gallery: https://portal.kinesis.network/dashboard/gallery
Docs: https://docs.kinesis.network/getting-started/running-llms-with-kinesis-network/creating-apps-with-app-gallery

Categories: LLMs with Open WebUI, vLLM Multi-GPU, General Purpose. Template sheet: **Quick Launch** or **Customize First**. Match the template to the workload: General Purpose / No GPU for a tiny monitor; LLM or multi-GPU templates when the task is that. Always quote the on-screen cost and confirm before Launch.

## Wizard

Docs (stale names): https://docs.kinesis.network/getting-started/running-llms-with-kinesis-network/creating-an-app-from-scratch

1. **Source** — GitHub (Beta), DockerHub (image+tag, optional registry auth), Docker Link, Upload. Docs omit Upload; live Source has it.
2. **Runtime** — env vars, ENTRYPOINT/CMD, post-start.
3. **Network** — ports / load balancer, custom domain, inbound allowlist.
4. **Execution** — Service / Tasks / Scheduled (coming soon). Preemptable, Auto-Scale, min/max replicas. Restart Policy: Restart Mode (Always), Start Timeout, Max Error Tolerance, Max Retries Per Node.
5. **Resources** — New grid / existing grid / Serverless. Memory, storage, GPU accelerator (or No GPU). Geographic: Most Cost Effective or Customize (US East/Central, Canada East/Central, Europe West). Estimated monthly cost is shown. **Launch App**.

**New grid → Advanced → Hold Behavior**
- Default: **Release spot instances when idle**.
- **Keep warm — Hold machines while your apps are stopped. You keep paying for them.**
- Idle release cooldown (minimum 5 minutes; UI has shown 15 minutes).

After launch: Logs, Terminal, Metrics, History, Config, endpoint URL. Public URL may 503 until the load balancer is ready. Then **Stop Apps**. Delete the app if the owner wants it gone.

## Choose a server (My Servers)

https://portal.kinesis.network/dashboard/my-servers Empty: **Add Servers**.

- **From Cloud Providers**: provider Kinesis; region e.g. Canada Central ca-central; Instance Type; count; storage GB; **Provision Servers**.
- Catalog mixes cheap CPU rows (e.g. Compute Micro) and GPU rows (A4000, A100, H100, …). Pick the row that matches the workload. Quote **Total when Active** vs **Total when Hibernated** from the screen that day. Confirm before Provision.
- **Bring Your Own**: install command with a short-lived `PROVISION_TOKEN`. Never paste the token into chat. Do not run it on a random laptop.

Provisioning can sit on **Awaiting … Queuing…** and disappear without billing. If the row never becomes selectable, do not claim the server exists.

Bulk actions (need a selected node): **Wake**, **Hibernate**, **Smart Lifecycle**, Add to grid, Remove from grid, Deprovision, Clear.

Hibernate is **explicit** on owned servers, not only automatic. Docs: a grid server bills full price while any app is Running/Starting, and storage-only when all apps are Stopped (hibernated).

## Grids

https://portal.kinesis.network/dashboard/grids
Create Grid: name, Add Dedicated, Add Spot, Choose an Existing Instance. Empty grid with 0 machines may **silently reject** Create Grid — do not invent a success. Spot dialog can default to H100; if the task does not need GPU, change it; if it does, quote the on-screen rate and confirm.

In-grid “Choose an Existing Instance → Save changes” has failed to persist. Workaround that worked: My Servers → select node → **Add to grid**.

## Watch

Docs: [Monitoring Apps](https://docs.kinesis.network/getting-started/running-llms-with-kinesis-network/monitoring-apps)

After launch it can take about a minute to provision. Endpoints are upper right. Tabs: **Logs** (per server if multiple), **Terminal** (SSH into the container per server tab), **Metrics** (live or custom range). Live UI has also shown History and Config.

Monitoring sidebar is empty until an app exists. Cost Analysis: actual / forecast / budget, date ranges, cost by project/provider/resource.

## Billing and settings (read unless asked)

Billing: credit balance, payment card, Add Funds (do not click unless asked), auto-reload Edit (threshold / top-up, Cancel if only looking), Redeem voucher (do not redeem unless asked), Credits vs Charges, invoices Download. Never handle card numbers; the owner types those in the portal.

Settings on a Google-login account has shown: Personal information, Theme, SSH keys only. Do not add keys or change name unless asked.

## Hard rules

1. Quote estimated cost before Launch App or Provision Servers. Confirm spend. Then pick the hardware the task actually needs, GPU included.
2. Do not invent SKUs or prices. Use what is on the screen that day.
3. Stop or deprovision before you leave so credits stop burning.
4. Provide / listing machines is [kinetization-of-idle-compute](sand-workflow:kinetization-of-idle-compute).

# Kinetization of idle compute

You **run Provide** for the machine owner. Live UI at [portal.kinesis.network](https://portal.kinesis.network) wins over this file and over [docs.kinesis.network](https://docs.kinesis.network). Demand-side apps are [kinesis-compute-apps](sand-workflow:kinesis-compute-apps). URLs: [kinesis-network-links](sand-workflow:kinesis-network-links).

**Customer** = grid renter. Skill user = **machine owner**.

Kinetized compute is a **whole machine** listed as **spot**. A Grid uses it when **Rented**. Customers do not pick this host by name.

## Hard rules

1. Do not invent fees, take rate, You earn, or payout rails. Docs do not publish dollar amounts.
2. Never print provision tokens, node keys, SSH keys, or passwords.
3. Confirm before Pause, Remove, Withdraw, uninstall, or power-off.
4. Do not Remove / uninstall / power off while **Rented** unless the owner accepts the lease rules below.
5. Do not list the agent computer as a provider host unless the owner said that machine is the one to onboard.
6. Choose the owner’s OS in Add machines.
7. Keep the machine powered, on the network, and running the Kinesis agent for the listed window.

## Identity firewall (docs)

[What is Kinetized Compute?](https://docs.kinesis.network/getting-started/kinetization-of-idle-compute/what-is-kinetized-compute)

- Customers see hardware, location, and a Kinesis price. They do not see who the provider is.
- Providers see **Idle** or **Rented**. They do not see the renter or the app.
- You do not pick the customer or the app.

## Access

Flip **Provide**.

### Start providing gate

Live path: https://portal.kinesis.network/dashboard/provider/apply Copy: “Start providing / Turn idle GPUs into income on the Kinesis network.” Cards: Plug in, Get rented, Earn monthly.

There is a **Kinesis Network Supply Agreement** (sections 1–8). Live UI has shown §8 as a placeholder pending final legal review, and **Agree & start providing** may not navigate even with the checkbox ticked (Fleet then redirects to apply).

If Agree does not work: stop, tell the owner Fleet is gated, and do not pretend you listed a machine.

If Agree works: only click it when the owner explicitly accepts the agreement.

### After Fleet exists

| Surface | URL |
|---|---|
| Fleet | https://portal.kinesis.network/dashboard/provider/fleet |
| Availability & Pricing | https://portal.kinesis.network/dashboard/provider/availability-pricing |
| Earnings | https://portal.kinesis.network/dashboard/provider/earnings |

Docs: [Kinetization](https://docs.kinesis.network/getting-started/kinetization-of-idle-compute), [What it is](https://docs.kinesis.network/getting-started/kinetization-of-idle-compute/what-is-kinetized-compute), [Expectations](https://docs.kinesis.network/getting-started/kinetization-of-idle-compute/expectations-from-providers), [Onboard](https://docs.kinesis.network/getting-started/kinetization-of-idle-compute/onboard-your-compute), [Earnings](https://docs.kinesis.network/getting-started/kinetization-of-idle-compute/reports-performance-and-earnings), [Offboard](https://docs.kinesis.network/getting-started/kinetization-of-idle-compute/offboard-your-compute)

Onboard (when Fleet opens):

1. Add machines → choose environment → run install command **on the host** → Go to fleet.
2. Row **Needs setup** → Set up → window (Until I change it / Until a date), notice default 24 hrs, You earn filled from specs → **List as spot capacity**.
3. Row becomes **Idle**. The machine can be matched. Earnings start when **Rented**.

Statuses: Needs setup (not listed), Idle (listed, unpaid), Rented (a Grid is using it; earnings accrue).

Idle after listing is normal. Stay listed. Do not list twice. You earn **only while Rented**.

**You earn** is the hourly payout Kinesis sets from the machine’s specs. While Rented it is **locked**.

### Lease / window ([Expectations](https://docs.kinesis.network/getting-started/kinetization-of-idle-compute/expectations-from-providers))

- Extend the window anytime, including while Rented. Extending is free.
- Shortening or withdrawing a committed window during a lease is a **contract violation with a monetary consequence**. Amount is not published. Do not invent it.
- Pause while Rented stops **new** rentals; the current rental continues.
- Remove becomes available after the current lease ends. Do not promise the machine back tonight.

### Earnings ([Reports](https://docs.kinesis.network/getting-started/kinetization-of-idle-compute/reports-performance-and-earnings))

Earnings accrue hourly while Rented. Payouts monthly. Before any rental: **No earnings yet**. After rented hours: **Accrued this period**, **Balance owed**, **Paid out to date**, **Next payout**.

How-it-works also says contributing idle resources can earn **credits**. Kinetization pages speak of monthly payouts. Docs do not reconcile those. Do not pick one as the only truth.

### Offboard ([Offboard](https://docs.kinesis.network/getting-started/kinetization-of-idle-compute/offboard-your-compute))

- **Pause** — withdraws from spot, stays onboarded. Relist with Set up → List as spot capacity. Idle → Needs setup. Confirm: Pause anyway.
- **Remove** — withdraws the listing and uninstalls the Kinesis agent. To use the host again, run the install command. Confirm: Remove machine.

## Failures

| Symptom | What to do |
|---|---|
| Agree button no-ops / fleet redirects to apply | Gate is broken or not enabled for this account. Stop. |
| No Provide | Wrong toggle or account. |
| Install fails | Fresh command on the host. |
| Host never Needs setup | Agent did not register. |
| Remove while Rented | Explain lease. Offer Pause for new rentals only. |

## Support

Portal Support, https://docs.kinesis.network/support, Discord https://discord.gg/ur9g7EctPt, email support@kinesis.network.

# Kinesis Network links

Canonical URLs for operating Kinesis. Do not invent paths. If a link 404s, use [docs sitemap](https://docs.kinesis.network/sitemap.md) or [llms.txt](https://docs.kinesis.network/llms.txt). Live portal wins over docs when they disagree.

Markdown for any docs page: append `.md` to the URL. Docs also support `?ask=` on a `.md` URL when you need a clarification from GitBook.

## Sites

- Marketing: [kinesis.network](https://kinesis.network) (`kinesiscloud.com` redirects here)
- Portal: [portal.kinesis.network](https://portal.kinesis.network)
- Docs: [docs.kinesis.network](https://docs.kinesis.network)
- Docs index: [llms.txt](https://docs.kinesis.network/llms.txt), [sitemap.md](https://docs.kinesis.network/sitemap.md)

## Portal (Compute)

- Projects: https://portal.kinesis.network/dashboard/projects
- App Gallery: https://portal.kinesis.network/dashboard/gallery
- My Servers: https://portal.kinesis.network/dashboard/my-servers
- My Grids: https://portal.kinesis.network/dashboard/grids
- Cost Analysis: https://portal.kinesis.network/dashboard/cost
- Monitoring: https://portal.kinesis.network/dashboard/monitoring
- Billing (Balance and Payment): https://portal.kinesis.network/dashboard/billing/payment

Guessing `/dashboard/cost-analysis` redirects to projects. Use `/dashboard/cost`.

Do not Add Funds, Edit auto-reload, redeem a voucher, or type a card unless the owner asked. Never print card numbers.

Monitoring is empty until an app exists: live copy has been “No Applications Found / Deploy an application to start monitoring performance metrics”.

## Portal (Provide)

- Start providing / apply: https://portal.kinesis.network/dashboard/provider/apply
- Fleet: https://portal.kinesis.network/dashboard/provider/fleet
- Availability and pricing: https://portal.kinesis.network/dashboard/provider/availability-pricing
- Earnings: https://portal.kinesis.network/dashboard/provider/earnings

If Fleet redirects to apply, the Supply Agreement is still gating. Stop. Do not pretend the machine is listed. Agree is disabled until the checkbox is ticked; do not tick or click unless this owner explicitly accepts.

## Docs (Compute / getting started)

- Welcome: https://docs.kinesis.network/welcome-to-kinesis-network
- What you can do: https://docs.kinesis.network/what-you-can-do-with-kinesis
- How it works: https://docs.kinesis.network/understanding-how/how-does-kinesis-network-work
- Running LLMs: https://docs.kinesis.network/getting-started/running-llms-with-kinesis-network
- Creating a project: https://docs.kinesis.network/getting-started/running-llms-with-kinesis-network/creating-a-project
- App Gallery: https://docs.kinesis.network/getting-started/running-llms-with-kinesis-network/creating-apps-with-app-gallery
- App from scratch: https://docs.kinesis.network/getting-started/running-llms-with-kinesis-network/creating-an-app-from-scratch
- Compute sources (Shared vs Grids): https://docs.kinesis.network/getting-started/running-llms-with-kinesis-network/understanding-compute-sources
- Grids: https://docs.kinesis.network/getting-started/running-llms-with-kinesis-network/understanding-grids
- Monitoring: https://docs.kinesis.network/getting-started/running-llms-with-kinesis-network/monitoring-apps

Docs still name wizard steps Source / Runtime / Network / **Hardware** / **Location**. Live portal wizard is Source / Runtime / Network / **Execution** / **Resources**. Click the live tabs. Tell the owner the docs still say Hardware/Location.

Docs have **no** Getting Started page for provision / Wake / Hibernate / Deprovision. Those exist on the live portal (My Servers). Live UI wins. Do not invent SKUs or prices; docs publish none.

## Docs (Provide)

- Kinetization overview: https://docs.kinesis.network/getting-started/kinetization-of-idle-compute
- What is kinetized compute: https://docs.kinesis.network/getting-started/kinetization-of-idle-compute/what-is-kinetized-compute
- Expectations: https://docs.kinesis.network/getting-started/kinetization-of-idle-compute/expectations-from-providers

- Reports and earnings: https://docs.kinesis.network/getting-started/kinetization-of-idle-compute/reports-performance-and-earnings
- Offboard (Pause / Remove): https://docs.kinesis.network/getting-started/kinetization-of-idle-compute/offboard-your-compute

## Support

- Docs: https://docs.kinesis.network/support
- Email: support@kinesis.network
- Discord: https://discord.gg/ur9g7EctPt

## Install (BYO / Dynamo)

Script: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kinesis-network/kinesis-dynamo-releases/refs/heads/main/install.sh

Never paste a `PROVISION_TOKEN` into chat. Run the portal’s one-time command on the owner’s host only.
